reports.notes: Handwritten summary page. The hundreds digit of the Line 2 figure is ambiguous between 5 and 6 in this filer's hand in both columns; transcribed as 6,657.58 at medium confidence because the same figure is written more crisply on Line 6. Line 3 is a handwritten bare 0. Page 4 is a typed 'Schedule A Itemized Contributions Received page 2/2' listing, NOT a second summary page - one report only. The summary page's own header reads '2016 County & Local School Board Candidates' (a 2016-vintage form sheet used for this 2018 filing); its Page/Last Name/Date of Report boxes were left blank by the filer.

contributions.detail: The filer replaced the county's Schedule A form with her own typed two-page spreadsheet, hand-headed 'Schedule A Itemized Contributions Received page 1/2' and 'page 2/2'. PDF p3 carries 47 rows summing to 1,894.78 = its own printed subtotal to the cent; PDF p4 carries 30 rows summing to 5,385.36 = its own printed subtotal to the cent; 1,894.78 + 5,385.36 = 7,280.14 = the ledger's printed grand total = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell. THE IN-KIND CONVENTION IS THE OPPOSITE OF THE OTHER COMMISSION FILING IN THIS CHUNK: three rows are marked 'in kind' in the donor cell (Facebook 50.00, MG Graphic Design 1,845.36, Ann Bryner videos 1,000.00) and ALL THREE ARE INSIDE the printed subtotals — monetary-only would fall 2,895.36 short of 7,280.14, monetary-plus-in-kind closes exactly. THE IN-KIND FINDING IS THE HEADLINE: three gifts are entered TWICE, once as a contribution and once as an offsetting expenditure of identical date and amount, and both stated Column A figures include them — the same double-entry convention §G1 records for Voeks 2016, occurring here in 2018, while ANOTHER 2018 Commission filing in this very chunk (Ellingson) excludes its single in-kind row from Column A. Two filings, one cycle, one office, opposite conventions. DATE FORMAT — WORTH FLAGGING DOWNSTREAM: every date on all three ledgers is typed in the spreadsheet form `D-Mon-YY` ('11-Nov-17', '5-May-18'), which is NOT one of the separator forms the build's normalizer is documented to parse (M/D/YY(YY) with / - or .). The dates are complete and unambiguous and are recorded verbatim as the contract requires; if they normalize to blank downstream that is a parser gap, not a transcription gap. ROW-INDEX TRAPS SCREENED: on all three ledgers the first data row sits directly under the printed column header (crop-proved), there is no banner, voided or continuation line, the one-past-the-end control rendered a printed subtotal or total on every page and never a further entry, and the ONE doubled band — p5's merged 62.39-66.03 — was split and BOTH halves crop-proved to distinct real rows (§F6/§H3). FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: the ledgers print their own column headers and every cell's content matches its header, with two benign exceptions recorded on the rows themselves (a location cell holding 'Paypal donation' instead of an address, and a location cell holding only a state name). PRIVACY: this filing is NOT redacted and prints full street lines for most donors; every one was reduced to city/state at READ TIME and no street line was carried into any field or note.
